The top game on Steam Deck's top-played list for the past year is **Slay the Spire 2**. I filtered its store reviews to "Over 100 hours" and "Played mostly on Steam Deck". The page showed the sort order as "Most helpful", but I didn't see an overall count for the combined filters.

Both filter chips were showing, and the first review I checked was from a SteamOS player. The reviews are all from Early Access.

**Mixed review**
- **Aurelian** (Not Recommended, 269.2 hrs, posted Sept 23, 10 found it helpful): "aeonglass is the most poorly designed, run-mandating, roguelike boss I've ever encountered. bafflingly bad. rest of the game, great improvement on sts1."

**Short positive reviews**
- **firehands11** (239.3 hrs): "Great game! Can be a steep learning curve but hours of fun once you get into it."
- **chr_graf** (443.4 hrs): "Love it thx to all in the dev team."
- **kooolm** (321.5 hrs): "I've played it a couple times and it's not bad."
- **WHAT THE YOTS** (268.5 hrs): "this is the classic of the genre, back to redefine excellence once again."
- **Zyararara** (163.9 hrs): "Another absolute classic, a must play for any and all roguelike enjoyers."
- **Raymonddog** (160.3 hrs): "Very simple to understand and very enjoyable to try and master!"
- **bernhard.matthieu** (127.8 hrs): "A genre defining game that sticks hours after hours!"
- **jooshua** (127.1 hrs): "Still haven't beaten the jaw worm."
- **123djvolschenk** (106.7 hrs): "Cards go wirrrrr and I am either very angry or happy. There is no in between."

Most of these reviews are only a line or two. The one complaint is about the Aeonglass boss.
